Entries.Original: And that's everything locked up. Phew, made it through the night!
Hello Minori. I'm so proud of you.
Ichiko? What are you doing here? Did something happen?
I was worried, so I came to check up on you. How was bartending?
I was pretty nervous at first, but it was fun! If I wasn't already a deliverywoman, maybe I'd have ended up being a bartender!
Remember that manga you drew a long time ago that was set in a bar? I used it for inspiration!
Oh, that's wonderful! I know just how much you love that story about how Dad proposed to Mom.
Uh, actually I was telling everyone that story just now. They were totally hooked.
It's been a while since I thought about that story... How Mom and Dad met at a bar in Hakone. I've always wanted to visit the place, y'know?
Yes... We still haven't visited Mom's grave in Hakone, have we?
Well, Hakone's been retaken. I'm sure all of us will get the chance to visit one day.
Alright, it's already pretty late. Let's head back, Ichiko.
Yes, let's. Oh, and would it be alright if I drop in on you tomorrow night, as a customer?
Oh yeah, of course! I'll make sure to deliver you one real special night!
